The investigator inactivates a gene encoding a protein that physiologically excises nucleotides from damaged, bulky, helix-distorting DNA strands. A patient with a similar defect in this gene is most likely to present with which of the following findings?

Options:
opa. Malignant breast and ovarian growths
opb. Dry skin and increased photosensitivity
opc. Colorectal and endometrial cancers
opd. Leukocoria and a painful bone mass
ope. Ataxic gait and facial telangiectasias
